*LCNetV4, a height pool, LightSVTR, and a CTC head.*

Softmax is over the class axis. CTC decoding in `ocr` reads the argmax,
so the probabilities are what the checkpoint’s inference graph emits.

*3x2 average pool. Recognition features are one row tall afterwards.*

The squeeze and unsqueeze put a singleton height back. LightSVTR still
wants NCHW, and it removes that height itself when it builds the
sequence.
